data-nifc-opendata-arcgis-com.title: NIFC Open Data (WFIGS wildfire incidents and perimeters)

post.description: Is anything burning near this ranch or parcel right now, how big is it and how contained? Use fire_history_for_geometry for past fires and incident_detail for one incident's full record.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

geometry.description: GeoJSON (RFC 7946, WGS84, [lon, lat]) Point, Polygon, MultiPolygon, or a Feature wrapping one. Foreign members (properties, id, bbox, crs) pass through unused. FeatureCollection, GeometryCollection, lines and antimeridian-crossing shapes are refused as invalid_input with a JSON pointer and a stable code (ring_not_closed, latitude, longitude, too_large, antimeridian, feature_collection, outside_coverage).

include_rx.description: Include prescribed fires (IncidentTypeCategory RX). Default true.

radius_km.description:
Search radius around the geometry in kilometres (default 25, max 200).

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 200; default 25.

value.active_window_note: WFIGS_Incident_Locations_Current lists incidents flagged ActiveFireCandidate and modified within roughly the last 3 days (< 10 acres), 8 days (10-100 acres) or 14 days (> 100 acres), discovered since the start of the current fire season; an incident absent here may still be burning but unreported.

sources.name: WFIGS Current Interagency Fire Incident Locations

200.description:
Active wildfire and prescribed-fire incidents within radius_km of a GeoJSON geometry (WFIGS current incident locations), each with size, containment, discovery date, cause, distance to the geometry and, when published, its current perimeter with whether it intersects the geometry.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `incidents` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cause` | string |  |
| `city` | string |  |
| `contained` | string | YYYY-MM-DD (UTC) or null when the source has no value. |
| `controlled` | string | YYYY-MM-DD (UTC) or null when the source has no value. |
| `county` | string |  |
| `discovered` | string | YYYY-MM-DD (UTC) or null when the source has no value. |
| `discovered_at` | string | ISO-8601 UTC or null when the source has no value. |
| `discovery_acres` | number |  |
| `distance_km` | number | Distance from the input geometry to the incident point (0 when inside a polygon); null without a geometry. |
| `irwin_id` | string | IRWIN GUID in braces; joins every WFIGS layer. |
| `management_organization` | string |  |
| `modified_at` | string | ISO-8601 UTC or null when the source has no value. |
| `name` | string |  |
| `out` | string | YYYY-MM-DD (UTC) or null when the source has no value. |
| `percent_contained` | number |  |
| `perimeter` | object | The incident's current perimeter from WFIGS_Interagency_Perimeters_Current, related to the input geometry; null when no perimeter has been published. |
| `personnel` | number |  |
| `point` | number[] | Incident location [lon, lat]. |
| `size_acres` | number | IncidentSize, acres as reported. |
| `source_url` | string | FeatureServer query returning this incident's full record. |
| `state` | string | Point of origin state, e.g. US-TN. |
| `type` | string | IncidentTypeCategory: WF wildfire, RX prescribed fire, CX complex. |
| `unique_fire_id` | string | YYYY-UNITID-NNNNNN. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

post.description: Has this parcel burned in a recorded fire perimeter, when and how much of it? For what is burning now use active_fires_near_geometry.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

buffer_km.description:
Also return perimeters within this many kilometres of the geometry (default 0: intersecting only).

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 50; default 0.

end.description: Last day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD (default today). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

geometry.description: GeoJSON (RFC 7946, WGS84, [lon, lat]) Point, Polygon, MultiPolygon, or a Feature wrapping one. Foreign members (properties, id, bbox, crs) pass through unused. FeatureCollection, GeometryCollection, lines and antimeridian-crossing shapes are refused as invalid_input with a JSON pointer and a stable code (ring_not_closed, latitude, longitude, too_large, antimeridian, feature_collection, outside_coverage).

start.description: First day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD (default 20 years before end). The historic view is filtered by fire year. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

value.history_note: Perimeter history is only as complete as the agencies' submissions: the all-years view is sparse before ~2000 and many pre-2014 rows lack an IrwinID; WFIGS perimeters start in 2021. A parcel with no perimeter here may still have burned in an unmapped fire.

sources.name: InterAgency Fire Perimeter History, all years

200.description:
Recorded fire perimeters that intersect a GeoJSON geometry (or come within buffer_km of it) between start and end (default the last 20 years), from the interagency all-years perimeter history and the WFIGS 2021-onward perimeters, deduplicated; each with year, acres, agency, intersection and the fraction of the geometry covered.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `fires` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `acres` | number | GIS-calculated acres of the perimeter. |
| `agency` | string |  |
| `cause` | string |  |
| `county` | string |  |
| `coverage_fraction` | number | Fraction of the geometry inside the perimeter, estimated on a 32x32 sample grid; 1 or 0 for a point. Null when the geometry intersects but is too narrow or disconnected to sample. |
| `discovered` | string | Discovery date when the WFIGS layer carries one; the historic view has only the year. |
| `distance_km` | number | 0 when intersecting; otherwise the gap to the perimeter within the buffer. |
| `feature_category` | string |  |
| `intersects` | boolean | True when the perimeter touches the geometry (always true with buffer_km 0). |
| `irwin_id` | string |  |
| `layer` | string |  |
| `map_method` | string |  |
| `name` | string |  |
| `object_id` | number |  |
| `percent_contained` | number |  |
| `perimeter_date` | string | Date the perimeter was last edited (DATE_CUR / poly_DateCurrent). |
| `source` | string |  |
| `source_url` | string | FeatureServer query returning this perimeter with its geometry. |
| `state` | string |  |
| `type` | string |  |
| `unique_fire_id` | string |  |
| `year` | number | Fire year; null when the view carries a placeholder (0 or 9999). |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

post.description: Follow up an irwin_id or unique_fire_id returned by active_fires_near_geometry, fire_history_for_geometry or new_starts.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

include_perimeter_geometry.description: Return the perimeter's GeoJSON geometry (can be hundreds of KB for large fires).

irwin_id.description: IRWIN GUID, with or without braces, e.g. {C63FC371-BC70-4615-841B-B0838C21064F}.

200.description:
One WFIGS incident by IrwinID or UniqueFireIdentifier: every attribute of its incident-location record, dates normalised, plus its most recent published perimeter (summary, geometry on request).

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `incident` | object |  |
| `location` | object | Echo of the geometry the result describes (null when no geometry was supplied). |
| `matches` | number | Incident records matching the identifier (normally 1). |
| `missing` | object[] | Layers that did not answer; their records are absent rather than guessed. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `perimeter` | object | Most recently updated WFIGS perimeter (2021 onward) for this IrwinID; null when none has been published. |
| `sources` | object[] |  |
| `spatial_precision` | string | How closely the values describe the geometry: `point` when only incident points were compared, `polygon` when perimeters were. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
